title: Candidate read response
description: PERD REQ-CTX-006 and REQ-AMB-002: at most 20 candidates, newest first (occurred_at descending; ties by candidate_id ascending, an agent rule so the order is total). JSON Schema cannot check the order; the reader and the Python test over fixtures do. An empty list is a valid answer and means NO_TRANSACTION_MATCH, never 'no such transfer happened' (REQ-AMB-002). A tenant mismatch is not a response: core returns 403 and raises a security event (REQ-CTX-006), and an out-of-scope row does not exist for the caller.

Candidate.description: One masked, candidate-shaped record: only the fields resolution features need (REQ-CTX-006). The field list equals the candidates-api-shape lint's allowed names; a test compares the two.

counterparty_display.description: Masked display name. At most four consecutive digits, so no account number can pass (the D4 label rule); never an unmasked name.

direction.description: OUTGOING or INCOMING, the two values the synthetic generator uses; no SoT or PERD value list exists (raised as an open decision).
